news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Initiates Coverage of Perimeter at Buy, PT C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets started coverage of Perimeter Medical Imaging AI (TSXV: PINK; OTCQX: PYNKF) with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a C$0.32 close on July 13. The initiation cited the company's FDA-approved Claire OCT platform and its commercial ramp potential in breast cancer surgery.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter and Maintains Profound as Healthcare Top Picks
news.summary: Paradigm Capital designated Perimeter a new speculative-buy Top Pick with a C$0.95 target (stock closed C$0.275 on July 3), with analyst Scott McAuley arguing the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire positions Perimeter to accelerate commercial rollout and draw more market interest.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI CEO Presents Commercial Strategy Update at Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented a company update on current commercial strategy and upcoming milestones at the Planet MicroCap Showcase (June 16-18, Bellagio, Las Vegas), aimed at broadening the company's investor base ahead of its Claire commercial ramp.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Closes Final Tranche of Non-Brokered Private Placement
news.summary: Perimeter closed the second and final tranche of its non-brokered private placement of convertible debentures, issuing CDN$3,280,000 in principal, bringing total gross proceeds of the C$3.6 million financing to a close to shore up working capital during its commercial launch of Claire.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has not yet formally scheduled its Q2 2026 results conference call as of late July 2026; based on prior-quarter cadence a report is expected around late August 2026, with investors watching Claire commercial revenue ramp post-FDA approval.

catalysts.label: Intermountain Health systemwide rollout
catalysts.detail: Under the systemwide agreement signed in January 2026, deployment of Perimeter's S-Series/Claire OCT technology into additional Intermountain Health operating rooms across the Mountain West is expected to continue through 2026.

catalysts.label: Next-gen B-Series OCT with ImgAssist AI 2.0 pathway
catalysts.detail: Following positive pivotal trial data (breakthrough-device designation, CPRIT-supported), Perimeter's next-generation B-Series platform is expected to progress toward further regulatory/commercial milestones, though no confirmed FDA decision date has been disclosed.

pulse: Since winning FDA PMA approval for its Claire OCT system in March 2026 - the first AI-enabled imaging device cleared for intraoperative breast cancer margin assessment - Perimeter has been building sell-side coverage and investor visibility, picking up two new buy-rated initiations in July 2026 (Paradigm Capital PT C$0.95, Brookline Capital Markets PT C$1.54) while both remain well above the current ~C$0.30 share price. The company closed a small convertible-debenture financing in early June to fund its commercial ramp and continues expanding hospital adoption under its Intermountain Health systemwide agreement. Near-term focus is on Q2 2026 results (expected around late August) as the market watches whether Claire's FDA clearance translates into accelerating recurring revenue.
